sections.title: 五、选择填空
sections.instruction: 从A、B、C三个选项中,选出最佳的选项。

questions.prompt: ______ is very important and we need it to buy things we need.
questions.translation: 金钱非常重要，我们需要它来买我们所需要的东西。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“need it to buy things we need（需要它来买我们所需的东西）”可知，买东西需要的是金钱（Money），故选 B。

questions.prompt: I often ______ my pocket money in a saving box.
questions.translation: 我经常把我的零花钱存进储蓄罐里。
questions.explanation: “in a saving box（在储蓄罐里）”提示这里表达的是“存钱（save）”，故选 A。

questions.prompt: We must make good ______ when we buy things.
questions.translation: 当我们买东西时，我们必须做出明智的选择。
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 make good choices 意为“做出明智/良好的选择”，符合买东西时的语境，故选 B。

questions.prompt: I get some ______ every week from my mum and I buy things with it.
questions.translation: 我每周从妈妈那里得到一些零花钱，并用它来买东西。
questions.explanation: 根据“every week（每周）”以及“buy things with it（用它买东西）”可知，每周定期从父母处获得的是零花钱（pocket money），故选 B。

questions.prompt: I want to use my money to ______ some food.
questions.translation: 我想用我的钱去买一些食物。
questions.explanation: 固定句式 use money to do sth. 表示“用钱做某事”，用钱获取食物的动词是“买（buy）”，故选 A。

questions.prompt: Don't ______ too much money on snacks. They're not healthy.
questions.translation: 不要在零食上花太多钱。它们不健康。
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 spend money on sth. 意为“在某物上花费金钱”，主语通常是人，故选 B。

questions.prompt:
—How much is the pencil case?
—______
questions.translation:
—这个铅笔盒多少钱？
—20元。
questions.explanation: 问句 How much 询问价格，答语应用具体的价格回答“It's 20 yuan.”，故选 B。

questions.prompt: Just remember, gold is great, but it isn't ______.
questions.translation: 记住，金子很好，但它不是一切（不是万能的）。
questions.explanation: 结合课文故事与主题，黄金虽贵重但不是人生的全部，固定表达 not everything 意为“并非一切”，故选 A。

questions.prompt:
—______ are these eggs?
—They're 12 yuan.
questions.translation:
—这些鸡蛋多少钱？
—它们12元。
questions.explanation: 根据答语“They're 12 yuan.”（它们12元）可知是对价格进行提问，疑问词用 How much，故选 C。

questions.prompt:
—What do you do with your pocket money?
—______ I want to use it to have a pet dog one day.
options: I share it with people in need.
questions.translation:
—你怎样处理你的零花钱？
—我把它存起来。我想有一天用它来养一只宠物狗。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“I want to use it to have a pet dog one day（我想用它来养宠物狗）”可知说话者目前把钱存起来备用，故选 A。

sections.title: 六、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文,选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
One summer day, a grasshopper(蚱蜢) saw an ant carrying food. "Why are you so busy?" asked the grasshopper. "I am helping to [1] food for winter," said the ant. "You should do the same." "Why do you [2] about winter?" the grasshopper laughed. The ant kept working and said [3]. The grasshopper just played all day. When winter came, the grasshopper was cold and [4]. He asked the ant for [5]. The ant said,
"It's best to plan for tomorrow."

questions.translation: “我正在帮忙为冬天储备食物，”蚂蚁说。
questions.explanation: 根据常理，蚂蚁在夏天收集并储存（keep）食物以备过冬，help to keep 构成不定式短语，故选 B。

questions.translation: “你为什么要为冬天发愁呢？”蚱蜢笑着说。
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 worry about 意为“为……发愁/担忧”，蚱蜢嘲笑蚂蚁无须为冬天担忧，故选 A。

questions.translation: 蚂蚁继续工作，什么也没说。
questions.explanation: say nothing 意为“什么也没说”，蚂蚁专心干活，不理会蚱蜢的嘲讽，故选 B。

questions.translation: 当冬天来临的时候，蚱蜢又冷又饿。
questions.explanation: 夏天只顾玩耍没有储存食物，到了冬天自然又冷又饿（hungry），故选 A。

questions.translation: 他向蚂蚁乞求食物。
questions.explanation: 蚱蜢饥饿难耐，所以向蚂蚁索要食物（food），故选 B。

sections.title: 七、阅读理解 (A)
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文,判断句子正误,正确的写“A”,错误的写“B”。
sections.passage: A boy named Tim got two dollars from his parents. He put them in his hat. "I will save the money for something special," he said. On his way home, he saw a toy car. It cost two dollars. He wanted to buy it, but then he remembered his saving plan. The next day, he saw a man selling flowers. His mother loves flowers. He bought a flower for his mum with one dollar. His mother was very happy. Tim put the rest dollar back into his hat. He felt very good because he saved some money and made his mother happy.

questions.prompt: Tim got two dollars and put them in his hat.
questions.translation: 蒂姆得到了两美元并把它们放进了帽子里。
questions.explanation: 根据原文“A boy named Tim got two dollars from his parents. He put them in his hat.”可知题干表述正确。

questions.prompt: Tim bought a toy car for two dollars.
questions.translation: 蒂姆花两美元买了一辆玩具车。
questions.explanation: 根据原文“He wanted to buy it, but then he remembered his saving plan.”可知他克制住了消费欲望并没有买玩具车，题干表述错误。

questions.prompt: Tim bought a flower for his mother.
questions.translation: 蒂姆给他的妈妈买了一朵花。
questions.explanation: 根据原文“He bought a flower for his mum with one dollar.”可知题干表述正确。

questions.prompt: Tim spent all his money.
questions.translation: 蒂姆花光了他所有的钱。
questions.explanation: 根据原文“Tim put the rest dollar back into his hat.”可知他只花了一美元，剩下的一美元放回了帽子里，并没有花光所有钱，题干表述错误。

questions.prompt: Tim felt happy in the end.
questions.translation: 蒂姆最后感到很开心。
questions.explanation: 根据原文“He felt very good because he saved some money and made his mother happy.”可知他感觉非常好/开心，题干表述正确。

sections.title: 七、阅读理解 (B)
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文,选择最佳选项。
sections.passage:
A poor shoemaker had only enough leather(皮革) for one pair of shoes. He cut out the pieces for a pair of shoes and left them on his table. The next morning, he found the shoes perfectly made! He sold them and bought leather for two more pairs.

This happened every night. Soon, the shoemaker became successful.

He and his wife stayed up one night and saw two little elves(精灵) making the shoes. They made clothes for the elves to thank them.

The elves were happy and never came back, but the shoemaker was rich now because he learned to work hard and be kind.

questions.prompt: What did the shoemaker have at first?
options: Leather for one pair of shoes.
questions.translation: 鞋匠起初有什么？
questions.explanation: 根据原文第一句“A poor shoemaker had only enough leather(皮革) for one pair of shoes.”可知他起初只有做一双鞋的皮革，故选 B。

questions.prompt: Who made the shoes at night?
questions.translation: 是谁在夜里做鞋的？
questions.explanation: 根据原文“saw two little elves(精灵) making the shoes”可知是两个小精灵在夜里做鞋，故选 C。

questions.prompt: How did the shoemaker become rich?
options: He found a lot of money.
questions.translation: 鞋匠是如何变得富有的？
questions.explanation: 根据原文“He sold them and bought leather for two more pairs. This happened every night. Soon, the shoemaker became successful.”可知他是通过卖出做好的鞋子不断积累财富的，故选 A。

questions.prompt: Why did the shoemaker make clothes for the elves?
questions.translation: 为什么鞋匠给小精灵做衣服？
questions.explanation: 根据原文“They made clothes for the elves to thank them.”可知做衣服是为了向精灵表达感谢（To say "thank you"），故选 A。

questions.prompt: What does the story teach us?
questions.translation: 这个故事告诉我们什么道理？
questions.explanation: 根据文章末句“because he learned to work hard and be kind”可知，故事教导我们要勤奋努力并保持善良，故选 B。

sections.title: 七、阅读理解 (C)
sections.instruction: 阅读下面材料,选择最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Many families use a three-jar system(三罐系统) to teach kids good money habits. When children get pocket money, they split(分开) it into three jars with clear names. [HTML:

🏺 Three-jar money system 🏺

Spending Jar
for things you want RIGHT NOW
  • Candy
  • Small toy
  • Snack
Saving Jar
for things you want LATER
  • New bike
  • Nice doll
  • Cool game
Sharing Jar
for helping others
  • Friend's gift
  • People in need
] This easy way helps kids learn to use money well, think ahead, and know how to care for others.

questions.prompt: What do families use the three-jar system to teach kids?
questions.translation: 家庭用三罐系统来教导孩子什么？
questions.explanation: 根据短文首句“Many families use a three-jar system(三罐系统) to teach kids good money habits.”可知是教孩子良好的金钱习惯，故选 A。

questions.prompt: When kids get pocket money, what do they do with it?
options: Give it all to their parents.
questions.translation: 当孩子们拿到零花钱时，他们会怎么做？
questions.explanation: 根据短文第二句“When children get pocket money, they split(分开) it into three jars with clear names.”可知是将零花钱分装在三个罐子里，故选 B。

questions.prompt: What is the Spending Jar for?
questions.translation: 消费罐是用来做什么的？
questions.explanation: 根据图表中的说明“Spending Jar for things you want RIGHT NOW”可知消费罐用于购买当下立刻想要的东西，故选 C。

questions.prompt: Which jar is for a new bike?
questions.translation: 哪一个罐子是用来买新自行车的？
questions.explanation: 根据图表中 Saving Jar 下列出的项目“New bike”可知，买新自行车属于储蓄罐，故选 B。

questions.prompt: What can you do with the Sharing Jar?
options: Buy a gift for a friend.
questions.translation: 你可以用分享罐做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据图表中 Sharing Jar 下列出的清单“Friend's gift（给朋友的礼物）”可知，可以用分享罐给朋友买礼物，故选 C。

sections.title: 八、根据提示,写出所缺单词的正确形式
sections.instruction: 根据提示,写出所缺单词的正确形式。

questions.prompt: Dongdong always ______ (spend) his money on school things.
questions.translation: 东东总是把钱花在学习用品上。
questions.explanation: 主语 Dongdong 是第三人称单数，always 表示一般现在时，谓语动词 spend 应用第三人称单数形式 spends。

questions.prompt: We should ______ (save) money for future plans!
questions.translation: 我们应该为未来的计划存钱！
questions.explanation: 情态动词 should 后面必须接动词原形，故填 save。

questions.prompt: Let's buy some ______ (crayon).
questions.translation: 我们买一些蜡笔吧。
questions.explanation: some 修饰可数名词复数，crayon 的复数形式为 crayons。

questions.prompt: I wish for a ______ (gold) touch.
questions.translation: 我希望拥有点金术。
questions.explanation: 名词 touch（触碰/点金术）前需要 gold 的形容词形式 golden（金色的、点金的）作定语，golden touch 意为“点金术”，故填 golden。

questions.prompt: Tina ______ (smile) and said, "Hello!"
questions.translation: 蒂娜微笑着说：“你好！”
questions.explanation: 连词 and 连接两个并列谓语，根据 said 为一般过去时可知，smile 也应使用过去式 smiled。

questions.prompt: I, money, get, week, every, pocket (.)
questions.answer: I get pocket money every week.
questions.translation: 我每周都能拿到零花钱。
questions.explanation: 主语为 I，谓语为 get，宾语为 pocket money，时间状语 every week 放在句末，组成陈述句：I get pocket money every week.

questions.prompt: how, is, schoolbag, the, much (?)
questions.translation: 这个书包多少钱？
questions.explanation: 询问价格的特殊疑问句句型为“How much + be动词 + 主语?”，首字母大写，句末用问号，组成句子：How much is the schoolbag?

questions.prompt: are, these, ice creams, eight, yuan (.)
questions.answer: These ice creams are eight yuan.
questions.translation: 这些冰淇淋八元钱。
questions.explanation: 主语为 These ice creams，系动词为 are，表语为 eight yuan，组成陈述句：These ice creams are eight yuan.

questions.prompt: share, Maomao, with, likes, in, to, need, people, money (.)
questions.answer: Maomao likes to share money with people in need.
questions.translation: 毛毛喜欢和有需要的人分享钱。
questions.explanation: 主语为 Maomao，谓语为 likes to share，宾语为 money，固定短语 share... with... 表示“与……分享”，people in need 表示“有需要的人”，组成句子：Maomao likes to share money with people in need.

questions.prompt: what, you, spend, your, on, do, money (?)
questions.answer: What do you spend your money on?
questions.translation: 你把钱花在什么上面？
questions.explanation: 疑问词 What 引导特殊疑问句，助动词 do 提到主语 you 前面，固定短语 spend money on... 表示“在……上花钱”，句末用问号，组成句子：What do you spend your money on?

sections.title: 十、读后写
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文,根据短文内容,用适当的单词完成句子。
sections.passage:
A smart shopper knows the difference between "needs" and "wants". Needs are things you must have to live or study, like food, clothes, and books. Wants are things you want to have but can live without(没有,缺乏), like toys, video games, or expensive sneakers(运动鞋). Before you buy something, ask yourself,
"Do I really need this, or do I just want it?" If you don't need it, maybe you should save your money for something more important.

questions.prompt: A smart shopper knows the ______ between "needs" and "wants".
questions.translation: 精明的购物者知道“必需品”和“欲望物”之间的区别。
questions.explanation: 根据短文首句“A smart shopper knows the difference between 'needs' and 'wants'.”可知填 difference。

questions.prompt: Things like food and books are our ______, because we must have them to live or study.
questions.translation: 像食物和书本这样的东西是我们的必需品，因为我们生活或学习必须拥有它们。
questions.explanation: 根据短文“Needs are things you must have to live or study, like food, clothes, and books.”可知填 needs。

questions.prompt: Toys and video games are our ______, because we can live without them.
questions.translation: 玩具和电子游戏是我们的欲望物，因为没有它们我们也能生活。
questions.explanation: 根据短文“Wants are things you want to have but can live without...”可知填 wants。

questions.prompt: Before buying something, we should ask whether we really ______ it or just want it.
questions.translation: 在买东西之前，我们应该问问自己是真正需要它还是仅仅想要它。
questions.explanation: 根据短文“Before you buy something, ask yourself, 'Do I really need this, or do I just want it?'”可知填 need。

questions.prompt: If we don't need a thing, we should ______ our money for something more important.
questions.translation: 如果我们不需要一样东西，我们应该把钱省下来用于更重要的事情。
questions.explanation: 根据短文“If you don't need it, maybe you should save your money for something more important.”可知填 save。
